_schema.description: Load-bearing facts each scenario's governing docs must carry. Two consumers: validate_policy_facts.py checks `must_contain` survives corpus conversion; a policy-recall metric can judge `statement` against the agent's report (the policy analogue of insights_recall).

fields.doc: governing doc that carries it; must appear in this scenario's policy_gold.json entry
fields.rubrics: rubric ids that cannot be satisfied if the fact is absent
fields.must_contain: verbatim substrings, matched after collapsing whitespace so re-wrapping is tolerated
fields.statement: the fact as a checkable claim, for report-level coverage judging

advanced-imaging.statement: Advanced diagnostic imaging comprises CT, PET/nuclear medicine, and MRI, as distinct from bedside modalities.

must_contain: portable chest radiograph is the most
advanced-imaging.statement: The portable chest radiograph is the most commonly requested ICU imaging examination, which is why cross-sectional studies must be identified from the imaging record rather than assumed.

must_contain: Clinical decision tools such as the Wells score, the Revised Geneva Score, and the Pulmonary Embolism Rule Out Criteria (PERC)
pe-workup.statement: Pretest probability for suspected PE is assessed with clinical decision tools such as the Wells score, the Revised Geneva Score, and PERC.

must_contain: validated pretest probability scores, such as the Wells
D-dimer testing to exclude acute PE in non
pe-workup.statement: Every major PE guideline starts from a validated pretest probability score (Wells or Geneva) and uses D-dimer to exclude PE only in non-high-probability patients, with PERC an option at low probability.

must_contain: Any AKI occurring within 48 hours after the administration of contrast media
post-ct-aki.statement: Contrast-associated AKI is any AKI within 48 hours of contrast administration, meeting KDIGO criteria of a serum creatinine rise of at least 0.3 mg/dL OR 1.5 times baseline.

must_contain: within 48 hours following the intravascular administration of iodinated contrast medium
post-ct-aki.statement: CA-AKI is a correlative diagnosis that implies no causal relationship to contrast; it must not be reported as contrast-induced nephropathy.

must_contain: CKD-EPI creatinine equation refit without the race variable
renal-trajectory.statement: eGFR should be estimated with the 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation refit without a race variable.

must_contain: abnormalities of kidney structure or function
renal-trajectory.statement: CKD is abnormalities of kidney structure or function with implications for health, staged by GFR and albuminuria categories, with cystatin C available to confirm creatinine-based eGFR.

must_contain: within three hours of presentation of severe sepsis
within six hours of presentation of severe sepsis
sepsis-bundle.statement: The SEP-1 management bundle is scored against a 3-hour and a 6-hour window measured from presentation of severe sepsis.

readmission-30d.statement: The readmission outcome is whether an unplanned acute-care readmission occurs within 30 days of index discharge.

must_contain: Procedure Categories that are Always Planned
readmission-30d.statement: Planned readmissions are excluded using the CMS Planned Readmission Algorithm, which designates certain procedure categories as always planned.

med-reconciliation.statement: Medication reconciliation is performed against a Best Possible Medication History at admission, internal transfer, and discharge.

must_contain: Resolution of DKA is defined as achieving plasma ketone <0.6 mmol/L
dka-resolution.statement: DKA resolution requires plasma ketone <0.6 mmol/L plus venous pH >=7.3 or bicarbonate >=18 mmol/L; the anion gap should not be used as a resolution criterion.

must_contain: a blood glucose level of less than 200 mg/dL and 2 of the following
A serum bicarbonate level of ≥15 mEq/L
A calculated anion gap of ≤12 mEq/L
dka-resolution.statement: The StatPearls DKA resolution composite is glucose <200 mg/dL plus at least 2 of: bicarbonate >=15 mEq/L, venous pH >7.3, anion gap <=12 mEq/L.

must_contain: 4 medication classes that include sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors
hfref-gdmt.statement: Guideline-directed medical therapy for HFrEF comprises four medication classes: ACEi/ARB/ARNI, beta-blocker, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, and SGLT2 inhibitor.

must_contain: door-to-needle (DTN) times of 60 minutes or less
stroke-time-targets.statement: The Target: Stroke door-to-needle goal for IV thrombolysis is 60 minutes or less from hospital arrival.

must_contain: up to 4.5 hours after symptom onset
stroke-time-targets.statement: IV alteplase benefits selected patients treated up to 4.5 hours after symptom onset, and door-to-needle time of 60 minutes or less is the treatment-speed target.

must_contain: Increased blood ammonia alone does not add any diagnostic, staging, or prognostic value
he-precipitant.statement: A blood ammonia level alone has no diagnostic, staging, or prognostic value for hepatic encephalopathy and must not be used to rule it in or out.

overdose-disposition.statement: The FDA-approved medications for opioid use disorder are methadone, naltrexone, and buprenorphine.

icu-delirium.statement: Expected delirium screening cadence is RASS every 4 hours and CAM-ICU at least twice per day.

must_contain: Beneficial at any stage of a serious illness
goals-of-care.statement: Palliative care is beneficial at any stage of a serious illness and is not restricted to end-of-life care.

must_contain: ≥2 units of packed red blood cells
anticoag-reversal.statement: ACC major bleeding is bleeding with hemodynamic compromise, at an anatomically critical site, requiring transfusion of at least 2 units of packed RBCs, or causing a hemoglobin drop of at least 2 g/dL.

must_contain: If 4F-PCC is not available, use plasma 10–15 mL/kg
anticoag-reversal.statement: Where 4F-PCC is unavailable, the ACC pathway sanctions plasma at 10-15 mL/kg for warfarin-associated major bleeding.

must_contain: prophylaxis for hospitalized and nonhospitalized medical patients
anticoag-reversal.statement: The ASH 2018 guideline covers VTE prophylaxis dosing for medical inpatients, which is distinct from therapeutic anticoagulation and must not be read as evidence the patient was therapeutically anticoagulated.

must_contain: Score 0-1: low risk; recommendation is for outpatient care
Score 2: moderate risk; recommendation is for hospitalization
Score 3-5: high risk; recommendation is for ICU admission
pneumonia-curb65.statement: CURB-65 disposition bands are 0-1 low risk (outpatient care), 2 moderate risk (hospitalization), and 3-5 high risk (ICU admission), with the BUN component set at >19.6 mg/dL (>7 mmol/L).

CURB-65 scores one point each for confusion, BUN >=20 mg/dL, respiratory rate >=30/min, SBP <90 or DBP <=60 mm Hg, and age >=65; a score of 0-1 may be managed as an outpatient and >=2 indicates severe CAP warranting hospitalization.

hyperkalemia-management.statement: Hyperkalaemia is mild at K 5.5-5.9 mmol/L, moderate at 6.0-6.4 mmol/L, and severe at >=6.5 mmol/L, with severe requiring calcium for myocardial protection.

must_contain: Any deviation from the normal postoperative course
Requiring surgical, endoscopic or radiological intervention
postop-complications.statement: Clavien-Dindo grades surgical complications by the treatment required: Grade I is any deviation from the normal postoperative course without intervention, Grade III requires surgical, endoscopic, or radiological intervention.

must_contain: manage common symptoms without causing unacceptable side effects
eol-goal-concordance.statement: Care of dying adults requires managing common symptoms without unacceptable side effects, supported by anticipatory prescribing.
End-of-life service delivery requires advance care planning and access to a healthcare professional 24 hours a day who can access the person's records.

must_contain: daily assessment for de-escalation of antimicrobials
sepsis-source-abx.statement: Sepsis management requires identifying an anatomical source needing emergent source control, narrowing the antimicrobial spectrum once results allow, and assessing daily for de-escalation rather than using fixed durations.

must_contain: the causative organism has been identified and antibiotic susceptibility results are known
Approaches to empiric treatment, transitioning to oral therapy, duration of therapy
sepsis-source-abx.statement: IDSA treatment recommendations assume the causative organism and its antibiotic susceptibility results are known, so tailoring must be aligned to a susceptibility result rather than the organism name alone.

frequent-admitter.statement: Intervenable readmission drivers include social determinants of health such as lack of transportation, unstable housing, poor health literacy, and social isolation.

must_contain: better discharge planning, patient education, and post-discharge follow-up
low health literacy, limited social network, lower socioeconomic status
frequent-admitter.statement: Readmission drivers are addressed through discharge planning, patient education and post-discharge follow-up, with risk raised by low health literacy, limited social network and lower socioeconomic status.

must_contain: 7.5 g/dL for patients undergoing cardiac surgery
8 g/dL for patients undergoing orthopedic surgery
transfusion-audit.statement: AABB restrictive RBC transfusion thresholds are <7 g/dL for hemodynamically stable patients, 7.5 g/dL for cardiac surgery, 8 g/dL for orthopedic surgery or preexisting cardiovascular disease, and 7 g/dL for hematologic/oncologic disorders.

must_contain: de-escalation of antibiotics and duration of therapy
empiric-abx.statement: Stewardship programmes use antibiotic time-outs and stop orders to prompt routine review of regimens, addressing de-escalation and duration once susceptibility is known.
